items.title: Zakura full node (Zebra fork) and Zakura Common crypto crates
items.summary: Rust Zcash full node forked from Zebra, with "Zakura Common" forks of librustzcash/orchard/halo2. Its sync, proving and verification speed-ups are self-reported by the project. Latest release: v1.7.0.
items.attribution: Claims from zakura.com and the zakura-core/zakura README; not independently verified and not measured in Brave Wallet.
braveEvidence: No zakura packages in brave-core Cargo.lock or DEPS (master); 0 brave-browser/brave-core issue or PR search hit(s) for "zakura".
